shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a flat vertical surface
horizontal registers/bands separating groups of figures
repeated row of similar figures in a line
justification: Both surfaces show low relief divided into stacked horizontal registers containing profile animals and repeated figures, which gives a loose compositional correspondence. But the content differs sharply: A shows highly schematic, isolated animal/creature signs (a large-headed quadruped, a bird-like head, an arm-like form) with no narrative linkage, while B shows naturalistic processions of costumed human figures with weapons, chariots and led animals moving in a single direction, a scheme absent from A.
